summary.text: Jon Bumstead is a Republican member of the Michigan Senate representing District 32, which includes all of Oceana, Mason and Benzie counties, most of Muskegon County and the western part of Manistee County.
His Senate biography says he was reelected in 2022 and previously served three terms in the state House.

paragraphs.text: Bumstead was born in Fremont and graduated from Newaygo High School and the Newaygo County Career Tech Educational Center Building Trades Program.
He began his own construction firm 39 years ago, and Bumstead Construction has built and remodeled many homes.

He was first elected to the Legislature in 2010 to represent the 100th District in the state House, served three terms, and was term limited in 2016; he was vice chair of the House Committee on Appropriations.
From 2018 to 2022 he represented the former 34th Senate District, where he chaired the Appropriations Subcommittee on Natural Resources and Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy.

He is a member of the National Rifle Association and Michigan United Conservation Corps, a member of several chambers of commerce, and a former volunteer firefighter with the Newaygo Area Fire and Rescue Command.
